_comment: ByteTrack runtime configuration. NONE of these values live in the .pth weights or in the OpenVINO IR network graph - they are consumed by host-side pre/post-processing and the BYTETracker. Source: ByteTrack repo exps/example/mot/yolox_x_mix_det.py, tools/track.py defaults, yolox/evaluators/mot_evaluator.py per-sequence overrides.

detector.output: [N, 23625, 6] = (cx, cy, w, h, obj_sigmoid, cls_sigmoid), decoded to input-pixel space

preprocess.resize: letterbox keep-ratio, r = min(800/H, 1440/W), cv2.INTER_LINEAR, top-left aligned

tracker.name: BYTETracker
tracker.motion_model: Kalman filter, 8-dim constant-velocity (x, y, a, h, vx, vy, va, vh)
